{{Quote|The DL-18 for my hip, the sleeve gun for surprise, and... yes the lightsaber. Old fashioned, but useful.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]|<ref name="BtEH">''[[Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand]]''</ref>}}
This '''[[Color/Legends|magenta]]-bladed''' '''lightsaber''' was a weapon carried by [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. Mara constructed this [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] from a rare [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] that [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] gave her when she became an [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]].<ref name="BtEH0">[[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 0|''Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand'' 0]]</ref> Though Mara had only rarely carried a lightsaber prior to her employment with [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Car'das/Legends|organization]],<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> she used this weapon with her [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], including in the [[Shelsha sector/Legends|Shelsha sector]],<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref> on [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]],<ref name="BtEH" /> [[Chibias/Legends|Chibias]]<ref name="Handoff">{{GamerCite|10|Handoff}}</ref> and [[Kintoni/Legends|Kintoni]].<ref name="ANotT">{{Tales|1|Mara Jade: A Night on the Town}}</ref> She lost it after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], during her [[Confrontation on Caprioril|duel]] with [[Lumiya]] on [[Caprioril]]. [[File:Handoff_G10.jpg|thumb|left|160px|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] with her lightsaber after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].]]Several years later, Mara Jade joined the [[New Jedi Order]] and constructed a new purple-bladed lightsaber as part of her training to become a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Dsc00048ad6.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Mara Jade Limited Signature Edition Lightsaber.]]
The official design of the lightsaber's hilt was released for the promotional images of Mara's model, [[Shannon McRandle]]. The most famous is the cover of [[Star Wars Insider 47]].

In [[2008]], [[Master Replicas]] released a limited edition (750 pieces) prop replica from Mara Jade's lightsaber. It was featured with a signed plaque by Shannon McRandle.<ref name="sandtroopers">{{WebCite|url=http://www.sandtroopers.com/sandwatch/lightsabers/mara_jade|text=Mara Jade Lightsaber|archivedate=20171016183134}}</ref><ref name="ultraforcesabers">{{WebCite|url=http://www.ultraforcesabers.com/master_replicas/limited_edition_lightsabers/mara_jade_se|text=www.ultraforcesabers.com|archivedate=20160121150817}}</ref>
